raw.query: WITH current_configs AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name FROM provenance.v_dim d WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.experiment = 'reactive' AND d.run_id LIKE 'reactive:r32%'), tail AS (SELECT i.run_id, MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99') AS ttft_p99_ms, BOOL_AND(i.is_violation) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99') AS ttft_p99_violates, MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'itl' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99') AS itl_p99_ms, BOOL_AND(i.is_violation) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'itl' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99') AS itl_p99_violates FROM provenance.v_infraction i JOIN current_configs d ON d.run_id = i.run_id WHERE i.is_current = true GROUP BY i.run_id), evidence AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name, s.mean_ttft_ms, s.mean_itl_ms, t.ttft_p99_ms, t.ttft_p99_violates, t.itl_p99_ms, t.itl_p99_violates FROM current_configs d JOIN provenance.current_llm_summary s ON s.run_id = d.run_id JOIN tail t ON t.run_id = d.run_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS configurations, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mean_ttft_ms < 500 AND mean_itl_ms < 50) AS configurations_meeting_mean_targets, MAX(mean_ttft_ms) AS max_mean_ttft_ms, MAX(mean_itl_ms) AS max_mean_itl_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ttft_p99_violates) AS configurations_violating_ttft_p99_sla, MAX(ttft_p99_ms) AS max_ttft_p99_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE window_name LIKE 'burst%') AS burst_configurations, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE window_name LIKE 'burst%' AND itl_p99_violates) AS burst_configurations_violating_itl_p99_sla, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'steady24h' AND itl_p99_violates) AS steady_configurations_violating_itl_p99_sla FROM evidence
raw.observed: 14/14 meet mean TTFT/ITL targets; maxima 322.1767634304047/9.290644897147597 ms. 14/14 violate TTFT p99 SLA; maximum 3494.725887000095 ms. 12/12 burst configurations violate ITL p99 SLA; 0 steady configurations do.
raw.claimed: All fourteen configurations satisfy mean TTFT/ITL targets of 500/50 ms; TTFT p99 reaches 3,495 ms and burst windows fail ITL p99.
raw.evidence: Current rows support every component: all 14 means are below target, all 14 TTFT p99 values violate the SLA, the maximum rounds to 3,495 ms, and all 12 burst configurations violate ITL p99.
